summary: Revised autonomy-score paper (docs/papers/autonomy-score/index.md): added third failure mode "outcome inefficiency" to §1 with bench-only measurability note (30× variance, Stanford/Microsoft 2026); §3 reframed machine-injected categories as "harness cost" matching dashboard; §4.3 rewritten to state DAG-via-Tarjan-condensation precisely and relevance-weighted edge splitting (blocking 1.0, context 0.5 default, T·w/W); §7 added "Outcome inefficiency is invisible" limitation citing Paper 001's 1.28× cheaper ON result. JS identifiers and /cron/usage endpoint untouched.
